label: GAD-7
citation: Spitzer RL, Kroenke K, Williams JB, Löwe B. (2006). A brief measure for assessing generalized anxiety disorder: the GAD-7. Arch Intern Med. 166(10):1092–1097. https://doi.org/10.1001/archinte.166.10.1092
license: No permission required to reproduce, translate, display or distribute. © Pfizer Inc. Free for all use.
description: A 7-item self-report scale for screening for generalized anxiety disorder and assessing anxiety severity. Each item rated 0–3 over the past 2 weeks.
scoring: 0–4: minimal; 5–9: mild; 10–14: moderate; 15–21: severe. Cut-off ≥10 for GAD diagnosis (sensitivity 89%, specificity 82%).
items: Feeling nervous, anxious or on edge
Not being able to stop or control worrying
Worrying too much about different things
Being so restless that it is hard to sit still
Feeling afraid as if something awful might happen
